kfbe01.title: Aries arrives 40 minutes early
kfbe01.caption:
The date is at 8. Aries has been there since 7:20, talking at double speed and already planning date 2.
Who do you know that shows up this early?

kfbe02.title: Taurus judges the date by the bread
kfbe02.caption:
Taurus gave the bread a 10/10 before the date even sat down. Then came the real test: the last bite.
What is your food dealbreaker?

kfbe03.title: Gemini tells a story inside a story
kfbe03.caption:
One story became a cousin, a bakery and space. The date added a fourth topic and Gemini fell a little bit in love.
Tag your favourite tangent person.

kfbe04.title: Cancer is already picturing the holidays
kfbe04.caption:
Four minutes in and Cancer is hanging two stockings in its head. Mum got mentioned, the receipt got kept.
Too soon, or right on time?

kfbe05.title: Leo gets a compliment back
kfbe05.caption:
Leo brought a 40-slide show about Leo. One sweet sentence from the date and the room went quiet.
What is the compliment that would get you?

kfbe08.title: Scorpio asks the deep question first
kfbe08.caption:
Menus closed, eye contact at 11/10, and the first question was about fears. The date answered for real and asked one back.
Deep first, or small talk first?

kfbe09.title: Sagittarius wants a second location
kfbe09.caption:
Sag had a backpack on and one foot out the door before the bread arrived. Then the date said four words: I like it here.
Which sign is always ready to leave?

kfbe10.title: Capricorn runs the date like a meeting
kfbe10.caption:
Agenda on the table, Q3 recap, the bill split to the cent. One question about fun and the phone went face down.
Who do you know that schedules feelings?

kfbe11.title: Aquarius asks the weird question
kfbe11.caption:
One giant duck or ten tiny dogs, as pets. Aquarius asked it on a first date and got a real answer with tiny jobs.
Duck or dogs? Go.
